status: adopted generator contract; individual feature implementation remains explicit
units: Minecraft blocks; no Earth elevation calibration

datum.heightmap: highest solid block Y; its geometric top is Y + 1
datum.average: authored target arithmetic mean: core highest-solid samples for elevation, diagnostic windows for relief, feature instances for width, and core samples for relative magnitude; exclude blend margins; not measured means or specified probability distributions
datum.elevation: inclusive planning envelope of core highest-solid heights; store offsets from engineSeaLevelY, the unchanged Y63 elevation datum
datum.relief: P95 minus P05 highest-solid height in a 256-block-wide interior diagnostic window; narrow forms use a 256-by-feature-width corridor
datum.width: short-axis footprint including flanks; not noise wavelength, spacing, or diagnostic resolution
datum.feather: vertical width of each soft eligibility margin inside the elevation envelope; not a horizontal terrain blend distance

allocation.note: Reserve 32 air blocks above the highest surface. The crust floor (minY) sits 400 blocks below the lowest surface (decided 2026-10-24): rock for geology, ore bodies and caves under every column, including the deepest sea floor. Realms continue below it to the world floor (worldMinY, user decision 2026-10-25; riven-realms.json), for a world 2048 blocks tall.

atmosphere.note: Cloud base for vanilla clouds and shader packs (WorldType.getCloudHeight). Above plateau tops (Y240); mountains and higher peaks rise through it, as vanilla mountains reach Y128 clouds.

sources.role: loads this contract: allocated bounds, sea datum, water top and the feature envelopes the terrain stages read
relative landform shape and observation scale; no numerical targets copied
CC capacity context; Riven allocation verified in local source

composition: Select broad landform intent from current continental, tectonic, geological and climate fields; elevation eligibility alone is insufficient.
Use overlapping soft windows and normalize qualified weights. Leave an explicit unresolved outcome if no geometry and context qualify; never force an elevation-only class.
Evaluate local relief and slope as model diagnostics or reuse declared prepared evidence; this reference adds no runtime neighborhood scans.
Apply relief within the selected parent footprint. Do not sum every feature maximum or impose a separate fixed world-Y band on a relative feature.
Admit a relative shape only when its full envelope, support and blend fit the world and geological headroom. Resize or reject it before evaluation rather than flattening overflow at a hard ceiling.
Water depth D below highest occupied water block W gives highest-solid bed Y = W - D; D=0 means no occupied water block above that bed.
Connectivity, supplied water, receiving levels, bed support, groundwater and climate qualification remain separate requirements; a height window supplies none of these proofs.
Caves, overhangs, arches and flooded caves require three-dimensional density/occupancy definitions. Springs, groundwater and snowlines have no universal heightmap band.

Referenced recipes adopt the broad height composition and habitat intent. Unimplemented local features, water proofs and future shape qualification remain explicit; this contract does not expand the world or change CC behavior.
